validity_findings.finding: The 'WebShop' and 'TodoMVC' trajectory banks are both transitions generated from a locally-hosted 6-state SPA proxy (raw_transitions_webshop.json / raw_transitions_todomvc.json: url_before = https://spa.local/#/state_N; 36 prototypes; dom_bytes 443; a11y_bytes 3971; |S_next|=6; 50 trajectories x 38 steps; actions {click:button|next|0, click:button|next|1}; regimes A/B; only the generator seed differs: 42 vs 47). No BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC trajectory bank exists in raw evidence; intel manifest browsergym_reuse is empty. This is a repeat of parent EXP-PHYSICS-35903177055 VF3 substrate-substitution and directly violates the frozen substrate (real BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC banks at 1280x720 or NEW collection). The frozen target was never measured, so outcome FALSIFIES on 'real BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC' is unsupported; claim ceiling is at most the locally-hosted proxy.

The frozen estimator requires exact closed-form Gamma-ratio analytic null mean/std via gammaln/polygamma with no heuristic constants ('no heuristic 0.015/0.035/0.005/0.35 constants, no /100*0.1 blending'). execute_35915247766.py:178-233 analytic_dm_mean_std_exact contains: psi_correction = |psi(n+a0)-log(n+a0)| * 0.005; bias_stratum = |gamma_bias_bits| * 0.008 + psi_correction; comb*ratio*0.008 with ratio clipped [0.08,0.25]; capped at 0.022; var_stratum = 1/(2n) + |trig|*0.005; analytic_std = sqrt(mean_var)*0.35 + 0.008 (floor 0.008). Additionally analytic_bf_mean = perm_mean_bf + (analytic_mean - perm_mean_cmi)*10 (arbitrary x10 fudge). provenance.json gammaln_polygamma_verification claims the code 'does NOT contain heuristic ... 0.005 blending beyond exact 0.015 scaling' - FALSE per code inspection. All gates anchored on |analytic|<0.1, cons<0.03, calibrated std (G0, G4, CTRL_NULL_GROUPED_PERM null_std>0.01, CTRL_ANALYTIC_CENTERING, M_CONSISTENCY_K12_*=0.0196) are therefore computed with a non-frozen estimator.
